title: stellaria laevis var. typica
intro: Stellaria laevis var. typica, commonly known as lesser stitchwort, is a plant species that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Stellaria laevis var. typica include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce swelling, lower body temperature, and relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
